Our point of view

Create with culture. Not just for it.

Not just a campaign. A collaboration worth creating.

MIDWELT brings strategy, talent relations, creative direction and production together in project-based teams. Instead of fitting a person into a campaign, we build the idea around the right creative connection.

We believe brands can contribute to culture, artists and athletes can protect their identity, and the two can create something more meaningful together.

Our approach

Identify. Shape. Bring to life.

01 / Identify

Find the right fit.

Understand the brief, the brand and the cultural landscape. Find artists, athletes and creatives whose perspectives align with the opportunity.

02 / Shape

Create together.

Develop the concept with the people involved. Agree the creative direction, contribution, commercial structure and practical requirements.

03 / Bring to life

Make it happen.

Assemble the right specialists, coordinate delivery and keep the brand and talent aligned from development to launch.

The collective

Not an agency of departments. A collective of creative minds.

We believe the best collaborations happen when the right perspectives come together.

Independent minds. Shared ambition.

Every idea deserves its own team.

MIDWELT’s model is designed around independent specialists, joined by shared creative values. We bring together the capabilities a project needs, instead of fitting it into a fixed agency structure.

No rigid hierarchy. No one-size-fits-all approach. Just the right combination of strategic, creative and commercial expertise.

Concept · Music

SOUND IN MOTION.

A musician’s sound becomes the starting point for a brand experience.

The concept

A new creative connection.

Imagine an electronic artist collaborating with a lifestyle brand on a limited-edition sound-led experience. The artist defines the sonic direction; the brand provides the context, resources and space to share it.

A brand seeking a genuine relationship with music communities rather than a short-term endorsement.

Potential collaborators
Independent musician × lifestyle or fashion brand
Possible formats
Original music, short film, live experience, limited-edition product
Proposed MIDWELT role
Cultural strategy, artist sourcing, concept development, licensing coordination and production planning.
All collaborations

Concept · Art & design

OBJECTS OF CULTURE.

Artistic practice translated into sculptural installations, objects and new spaces.

The concept

A new creative connection.

A proposed collaboration between an independent visual artist and a design or interiors brand would co-develop a physical object or temporary installation. The artist’s visual language remains at the centre of the collaboration.

A brand with a commitment to design that wants to involve an artist as an equal creative partner.

Potential collaborators
Visual artist × design or interiors brand
Possible formats
Editioned object, installation, editorial photography
Proposed MIDWELT role
Artist and brand alignment, co-creation, art direction, rights coordination and creative production.
All collaborations

Concept · Sports

BEYOND PERFORMANCE.

An athlete’s identity beyond the field, track or arena.

The concept

A new creative connection.

A proposed collaboration between an athlete and a sportswear or lifestyle brand could create a project rooted in the athlete’s personal story. A filmmaker and creative director translate it into a campaign that connects performance, style and identity.

An athlete looking for more expressive brand relationships, and a brand looking for an authentic cultural story.

Potential collaborators
Athlete × sportswear or lifestyle brand
Possible formats
Editorial film, photography, product collaboration, community event
Proposed MIDWELT role
Talent sourcing, partnership development, creative strategy and campaign production planning.
All collaborations

Concept · Fashion

CULTURE, CUT & FORM.

An artist’s creative language expressed through a limited-edition fashion capsule.

The concept

A new creative connection.

Imagine a fashion label collaborating with an independent artist or designer to translate their visual language into a tightly edited capsule. From silhouette to textile, each piece becomes a wearable expression of a shared creative vision.

A fashion brand looking beyond conventional endorsements to develop a product and campaign rooted in original creative practice.

Potential collaborators
Independent artist or designer × fashion label
Possible formats
Limited-edition capsule, editorial lookbook, launch campaign, pop-up experience
Proposed MIDWELT role
Talent alignment, co-creation, collection strategy, creative direction and launch planning.
All collaborations

Concept · Film & photography

THROUGH THE LENS.

A director’s visual perspective turns a brand story into a cinematic experience.

The concept

A new creative connection.

Imagine a filmmaker or photographer collaborating with a brand and creative talent to develop a visual narrative. An original short film and companion photographic series explore a shared theme through the director’s own distinctive point of view.

A brand seeking a culturally relevant visual story rather than conventional product-led advertising.

Potential collaborators
Independent filmmaker or photographer × brand × creative talent
Possible formats
Short film, campaign stills, editorial series, behind-the-scenes content
Proposed MIDWELT role
Director and talent sourcing, creative concept, visual treatment, production coordination and campaign planning.
